description: As part of Japan's public-private R&D investment programme PRISM, MLIT's Policy Bureau collected municipal infrastructure maintenance data through a prototype data linkage platform and published the bridge data as open data. Contents: bridge records for participating municipalities in Yamagata, Shimane and Nagasaki prefectures (eight files in total, for example Goto City and Shin-Kamigoto Town in Nagasaki), with bridge specifications, periodic inspection results and repair history in a common format. Producer: MLIT with the municipalities that own the bridges. Coverage: selected municipalities only; files were added between 2021 and June 2026. Format and access: GeoJSON downloads from the G-Spatial Information Center under the Japanese government standard terms of use (compatible with CC BY 4.0). Free. Caveats: a small pilot sample, not national coverage, and attributes follow Japanese inspection manuals, so condition grades need translation for international use. Simulation uses: training and testing deterioration and maintenance prioritisation models for small municipal bridges, and linking condition to network criticality in rural and island road networks. Related records: the MLIT Social Infrastructure Information Platform (data-japan-mlit-social-infrastructure-information-platform) gives national bridge inventories with inspection grades.
